description_en: Checks the expiration time and current status of the iOS certificate for a specified app
description_zh: 检测指定app的iOS证书过期时间及当前证书状态
name: CheckCertificate

Android.description_en:

true

Android.description_zh:

true

DevelopmentCertInfo.description_en: The information about the certificate for the development or sandbox environment
DevelopmentCertInfo.description_zh: 访问开发环境/沙箱环境的证书信息

ExipreTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

EXPIRED: The certificate is expired.

NOT_CONFIGURED: The certificate is not configured.

NO_PASSWORD: The password for the certificate is not configured.

OK: The certificate is normal.

REVOKED: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书状态，取值：

EXPIRED：已过期
NOT_CONFIGURED：未配置
NO_PASSWORD：未配置密码
OK：正常
REVOKED：已撤销
